description:
Today we’re taking a look at the FIFINE AmpliGame AM8 Pro T (AM8PROT), a complete budget USB and XLR dynamic microphone kit that includes a metal RGB boom arm right in the box. At around $79 on Amazon (with a cheaper non-RGB version also available), it’s a solid plug-and-play setup for game streaming, podcasts, and YouTube voiceovers without needing an expensive audio interface right away.

* FIFINE: https://fifinemicrophone.com/ with code FifineMic15 (15% off)
* Genie Software: https://fifinemicrophone.com/pages/fifine-genie-software
* US Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FLDM5BSX with code 10FIFINE (10% off)

Note: The entire voiceover for this video was recorded directly on the FIFINE AM8 Pro T over USB-C in Final Cut Pro with no background noise suppression or EQ tricks applied!
